pictures.author: Benjamín Núñez González
pictures.observed: Actually viewed864px whole-building photo: banded red brick/cream terracotta, tall lower and upper casements, canted central bay, slate mansards with pedimented dormers, paired stacks, decorated drum and large dark copper dome. A lower side door is visible; its exact bearing is not supplied.

pictures.author: Ethan Doyle White
pictures.observed: Actually viewed960px eastern elevation: three upper windows separated by molded pilasters, Gibbsian cream surrounds/brick bands, mansard end with tall pedimented dormer, small balustrade and paired-stack detailing. Lower entrance/level is partly obscured by a fence.

pictures.author: Elliott Brown
pictures.observed: Actually viewed1280px courtyard/corner view: full cross-wing/canted-core relationship, mansard roof/dormer and iron cresting, terracotta drum, dark dome/finial. Scaffolding is temporary and omitted. Caption identifies the eastern principal entrance as a first-floor entrance; exact access is not reconstructed.

pictures.author: Ethan Doyle White
pictures.observed: Actually viewed960px western elevation, partly obscured by trees: central upper casement grouping, oculus in gray roof cap, dark dome/finial and banded lower facade. Lower ground/door details remain partly hidden.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Independent South Building: full mapped cruciform two-storey body, banded red brick and pale terracotta, canted central bays, green-gray mansard roofs with pedimented dormers, four end pavilions and paired tall chimneys, raised decorated drum and broad dark copper dome. Reconstruct a lower west service entrance recess/soffit and three approach treads; entrance bearing and thresholds are approximate. Preserve the independent planetarium, Altazimuth Pavilion and all other campus buildings. Exterior only: no furnished galleries, working instruments, copied inscriptions, sculpture portraits or signs.
